source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-18

procedures.title: Door hinges: remove and install
steps: For the lower hinge, remove the door sill plate, cowl kick panel and radio speaker.
To reach the upper hinge screws, remove the lower mast jacket cover and the instrument panel pad (left side) or dash panel pad (right side), plus the air inlet ducts.
If removing the whole door on a car with power windows, disconnect and remove the wiring running between hinge pillar and door.
If the hinge will go back in the same spot, scribe around the inner strap on the door panel and note how many shims sit between hinge strap and door panel.
Remove the bolts holding the hinge to the door.
Remove the bolts holding the hinge to the body.
Installation: If the door was off the car, scribe around the lock striker (see Adjustments - Door Lock Striker) and take the striker off the lock pillar.
Install the hinges with the same number of shims as removed, lining the door hinge straps up with the scribe marks.
Adjust the door as needed.
On power-window doors, reconnect the wiring.
Refit all trim and panels removed for the job.
notes: Caution: never let the door hang unsupported on a single hinge.

procedures.title: Door sill plate and molding: replace
steps: The sill plate (which holds the carpet, cowl trim kick panel and lock pillar front edge trim) comes off by removing its 4 screws.
Replace the upper molding by removing its 7 screws.
To replace the lower molding, first remove the upper molding, then remove 5 screws and 4 nuts at the molding face.
notes: Assembly details: figure 41 in the manual.

procedures.title: Underbody storage compartment: remove and install
steps: Open the lid and lift out the right hand box.
Remove the 8 screws along the frame inner flange and the lower strap of the door hinges.
Lift the assembly up out of the underbody.
To remove the doors from the assembly, take out the screws at the upper hinge strap: 3 for each outer door, 2 for the center door.
Remove the center box via the 7 screws around its inside top edge.
Install by reversing these steps.
notes: Located just behind the front seats; divided into three separate storage areas. See figure 42 in the manual.

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid: adjust
steps: Hinges: Scribe a line on the lid following the hinge strap outline so lid movement can be seen while adjusting (see figure 44 in the manual).
Add or remove hinge shims to raise or lower the lid surface.
After any change of lid position on the hinges, inspect lock engagement and adjust if needed.
Lock: Move the lock striker in or out within its slotted mounting holes.
To adjust release, loosen the lock retaining bolts and slide the lock fore or aft within the slots in its base; for more adjustment, move the cable retainer in the needed direction.
Test the lock release afterward and readjust as required.
notes: Closed lid must sit flush with the surrounding body surfaces.
Parts identification: figure 43 in the manual.

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid hinges: remove and install
steps: Removal: Scribe around the hinge (see figure 44 in the manual).
Open the lid fully and remove the 3 retaining screws to take the hinge out as an assembly; note how many shims sit between hinge frame and compartment floor.
